_readme.what: Category knobs for jigsaw pool pieces (village houses above all). Each tag has a "multiplier" on the weight of every piece it contains: 0 = removed, 0.5 = half as likely to be picked, 2 = twice as likely. A piece's final weight = current (pool_config.json) x the product of every tag containing it. Rejoin the world to apply (patcherMod worldgen/PoolTuner, at every world load; new chunks only).
_readme.relative: Weights are relative within a pool: a village street picks each house with chance weight / pool total. Lowering one house makes the others (and the pool's minecraft:empty lot, if it has one) more likely; it doesn't change how many houses a village has.
_readme.values: Same syntax as structure_tags.json, applied to piece keys (template ids, see pool_config.json): "ns:path", globs ("immersiveengineering:*", "*_engineer"), "#other_tag", and "!" to exclude. An unknown explicit piece or tag is an error that applies NO pool tuning until fixed (listed in pool_tag_report.md); a glob that matches nothing is only a warning.
_readme.pools: Optional "pools": [globs] limits a tag to those pools, e.g. ["minecraft:village/desert/*"] for desert villages only. Without it, the tag applies wherever its pieces appear.
_readme.report: pool_tag_report.md lists every piece another mod injected into each pool (the fastest way to find a mod's village houses), each retuned pool's before/after chances, and every tag's members.

mod/immersiveengineering.note: IE's 5 village houses (engineer, machinist, electrician, gunsmith, outfitter) x 5 biomes, weight 1 each. IE has no config for them.

mod/dynamicvillage.note: Create: Dynamic Village's 4 Create-themed houses (mech, miner, plumber, train) x 5 biomes. Weight 20 EACH, far above vanilla houses (2-4), so they dominate villages. No config.

mod/pneumaticcraft.note: Mechanic house (weight from pneumaticcraft-common.toml addMechanicHouse, default 8) plus its custom streets in desert/snowy villages.

mod/advancedperipherals.note: Computer scientist house (weight from config/Advancedperipherals/world.toml villagerStructureWeight, default 10).
